chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-A'la ibn A'yan, who said:
I heard Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'One of the wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said,
Does Muhammad (peace be upon him) think that if he were to divorce us, we would not find our matches from our people?
He said: So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, was angered from above His seven heavens, so He commanded him, and he gave them a choice until he reached Zaynab bint Jahsh.
So she stood up, kissed him, and said, 'I choose Allah and His Messenger.'

key_terms.أَخْتَارُ اللَّهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ: I choose Allah and His Messenger

ai.seo_question: What is the story of the choice (Takhayyur) of the Prophet's wives in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the divine command for the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to offer his wives the choice between worldly life and Allah and His Messenger, a pivotal event known as 'Takhayyur'. It specifically highlights Zaynab bint Jahsh’s exemplary response, where she chose Allah and His Messenger, affirming her spiritual priority over social status or material comfort. This narrative underscores the unique status of the Prophet's wives as models of piety and their voluntary submission to divine will during a time of potential social disruption.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Abdul A’ala Bin ayn who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying that one of the wives of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> said, ‘Does Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> view that if he<sup>saww</sup> were to divorce us we would not find our matches from our people?’

So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic was Angered from above the seven skies. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded it, so he<sup>saww</sup> gave them a choice until he<sup>saww</sup> ended up with Zaynab Bint Jahash.
So she stood up, and kissed him<sup>saww</sup> and said, ‘I choose Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn abu Nasr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman from ‘Abd al-‘Ala’ ibn ’A‘yan who has said the following:
“I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘Certain ones of the wives of the Holy Prophet, had said, ‘
Does Muhammad think that if he divorces us, no one from our people will marry us?’

He (the Imam) said that Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, became angry from above the seven heavens and commanded him (the Messenger of Allah) and he gave them the choice until it was the turn of Zaynab bint Jahash.
She stood and kissed him (the Messenger of Allah) and accepted, saying, “I choose Allah and His Messenger.’””
